This policy explains which data Jauge uses, why, for how long and what your rights are. It applies to the Jauge app on Android and iOS and to the share pages jauge.io/a/.
1. Data controller
The data controller is the publisher of Jauge (see the Legal notice). For any question about your data or to exercise your rights: privacy@jauge.io.
2. Data we use

• Account: identifier, email address and name sent by Apple or Google, or typed by you. With "Hide my email", Apple sends us a relay address.
• Analyzed offers: pasted links, screenshots and photos, position, city and analysis results.
• Alerts: followed offers, alert thresholds and the notification token of your device.
• Subscription: Jauge Plus status, trial and renewal dates, sent by the App Store, Google Play and RevenueCat. We never receive your bank details.
• Consents: your choice to receive search tips by email or not.
• Technical: app version, system, language and error logs without personal content.

We collect neither your precise location, nor your contacts, nor your resume.
3. Why and on which legal basis

• Providing analyses, history, alerts and shares: performance of the contract (terms of use).
• Reading the offer and computing the estimates: automated processing (text reading, statistical and artificial intelligence models), as part of the performance of the contract. It makes no decision for you: it is a help, you remain free to apply.
• Managing the subscription and the free trial: performance of the contract.
• Sending search tips by email: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
• Sending notifications: your consent given to your phone, adjustable in its settings.
• Securing the service, preventing abuse and fixing errors: our legitimate interest.
• Meeting our accounting and legal obligations: legal obligation.
4. Your screenshots

Screenshots and photos are only used to read the offer. They are deleted from our servers as soon as the reading ends, and at the latest 24 hours after they were sent. Only the information of the offer (position, company, city, skills) is kept with your analysis. Do not take pictures of other people's personal data.
5. Who receives your data
6. Transfers outside the European Union

Some processors (RevenueCat, Apple, Google) may process data in the United States. These transfers are covered by the EU and US Data Privacy Framework when the provider takes part in it, or otherwise by the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.
7. Retention periods

• Screenshots and photos: 24 hours at most.
• Account, analyses, alerts and shares: as long as your account exists. After 3 years without any sign in, your account and its data are deleted after a warning email.
• Without an account: analyses linked to your device are deleted after 12 months of inactivity.
• After the account is deleted: immediate deletion in the app and complete within 30 days, backups included.
• Billing data held by the stores and RevenueCat: according to their legal obligations, up to 10 years.
• Technical logs: 12 months at most.
8. Your rights

You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, the right to withdraw your consent at any time and to set instructions about your data after your death.

In the app: "Export my analyses" gives you your data in an open format, "Delete my account" erases your account and your data. Without the app, you can also ask for the deletion of your account at jauge.io/supprimer-mon-compte. For any other right, write to privacy@jauge.io: we answer within one month.

If you believe your rights are not respected, you can file a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr) or the data protection authority of your country.
9. Security
Exchanges are encrypted (HTTPS), access to data is limited by per user security rules, passwords are never used (sign in with Apple, Google or an email link) and team access is logged.
10. Minors

Jauge is for adults only: you must be at least 18 to use the app and create an account. We do not knowingly collect data about minors: if you learn that a minor has sent us data, write to privacy@jauge.io and we delete it.
11. Trackers
The app uses no advertising tracker and no third party audience measurement tool. It only keeps on your phone the settings it needs to work (session, preferences).
12. Changes
If this policy changes significantly, we let you know in the app before the changes take effect. The date of the last update is at the top of this page.
These terms govern the use of the Jauge app and of the Jauge Plus subscription. By using Jauge, you accept them.
1. The service

From the link, screenshot or photo of a job offer, Jauge estimates the likely number of applicants, the salary of the offer and comparable calmer offers. Jauge is neither a recruiter nor an intermediary: we send no application. Analyses are produced automatically, by reading the text of the offer and by statistical models that may use artificial intelligence.
2. Estimates, not guarantees

The figures shown are statistical estimates based on public data and comparable offers. Their reliability is shown on each analysis. They may be wrong and guarantee neither the real number of applicants, nor the salary, nor the result of an application. Keep your own judgment.
3. Account

You can use Jauge without an account, or create one with Apple, Google or your email address to find your analyses on all your devices. You must be at least 18. You are responsible for the access to your account. You can delete it at any time from Profile, Delete my account, or from the page jauge.io/supprimer-mon-compte.
4. Free plan
Without a subscription, you get one complete analysis per week. An attempt that could not be read (unreadable screenshot) does not count.
5. Jauge Plus

Jauge Plus unlocks unlimited analyses, details, twin offers and "calm" alerts. It is a monthly subscription of €6.99 per month, all taxes included (price shown by the store in your currency), with a 3 day free trial for a first subscription.

Payment is made through the App Store or Google Play. Unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or of the current period, the subscription renews automatically every month at the same price.

You manage and cancel the subscription in the settings of your App Store or Google Play account, or from Profile, Manage or cancel the subscription. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. Deleting the app or your account does not cancel the subscription.
6. Right of withdrawal and refunds

By subscribing, you ask for immediate access to the service and acknowledge that your 14 day right of withdrawal ends once the service has been fully performed for the current period, in accordance with article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code. The free trial lets you try Jauge Plus without paying. Refund requests are handled by Apple or Google according to their rules.
7. Fair use

You agree to send only job offers, not to send illegal content or other people's personal data, not to automate analyses, not to extract results in bulk and not to bypass the limits of the service. In case of abuse, we may suspend access after warning you, except in an emergency.
8. Shares
When you share an analysis, a public link jauge.io/a/ is created with the chosen card. Anyone with the link can see it. You can delete the share at any time: the link then stops working.
9. Intellectual property
Jauge, its analyses and its content remain the property of the publisher. You may use and share your analyses for your personal use. The analyzed offers remain the property of their authors.
10. Availability and liability

We do our best to keep Jauge available and accurate, without being able to guarantee it at all times. We cannot be held liable for a decision made on the basis of an estimate, nor for an interruption caused by force majeure or by a third party (store, host, network). Nothing in these terms limits your consumer rights.
11. Personal data
The use of your data is described in the Privacy policy, available from the app.
12. Changes
We may change these terms. Significant changes are announced in the app at least 30 days before they take effect. If you refuse them, you can stop using Jauge and delete your account.
13. Disputes

These terms are governed by French law. If there is a problem, write first to contact@jauge.io. You can also use the consumer mediator free of charge: %1$s, or the European online dispute resolution platform. Failing an agreement, the competent courts are those provided by law, including those of your place of residence.
